title: Wendell and the Will
author: Petra Voss
blurb: Silas Galloway, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
